annotations.title: Launch film looks and scene types

description: Use it when the user wants the looks of a launch film, or the scene types its plan takes. Lists launch-film's looks and what each one suits (topic looks), or its scene types with their main fields (topic types). The lists come from the installed launch-film, so they hold every look and scene type it takes. It saves no file: the result is the list itself. It is for picking the look of plan_launch_film or make_launch_film, or for writing film.json, whose clip kinds, each type's other fields and the rules for the words on screen are in the film-json playbook. The launch-film playbook (makersmcp_playbook) has the whole job. (launch-film 0.3.1, on this machine.)

topic.description: looks, for each look and what it suits, or types, for the scene types and their main fields.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, counted from the start of the call, before returning a job_id to wait on. Some clients end a call after 60 or 240 seconds; 45 is safe in all of them.
